FN-NRGR88-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 1
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator April Weaver
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/21/2023
Senate Bill 1 as introduced would revise the rate at which an inmate may accrue correctional
incentive time; (2) increases the time period that an inmate must be in certain classifications
before moving to a different classification; and (3) provide additional violations that would
result in forfeiture of correctional incentive time. These provisions could result in a prisoner
serving a longer period of confinement in a local or state correctional facility than otherwise
provided by current law. The Department of Corrections (DOC) estimates the cost of housing an
inmate at approximately $80.00 per day.
Further, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of DOC to submit annual reports
to the Legislature, Governor, and Attorney General relating to correctional incentive time.
Page 1
